describe.summary: Leaves the owner tasks that act on nothing, so that everything around a task can be tested.

prepare.doc: Opens one task for the owner of the row the run names, and answers `awaiting_owner` with its id and hash. `seconds` is sealed with a `confirm_slow` task as the time its run takes.

params.name: title
params.doc: The task's title, 80 characters at most. `Tasks probe` when it is not named.

params.name: body
params.doc: Shown as the field `Body`, sealed in the task's state, and handed back in the result.

params.name: kind
params.doc: `confirm` (when it is not named), `text` or `file`: what the owner answers with; or `notice`, which asks nothing and is answered `notified`.

params.name: answer_by
params.doc: The operation that answers a `confirm` task, and the only one that may: `confirm` (when it is not named), `confirm_slow`, `confirm_silent` or `confirm_trap`. A `text` or `file` task is answered by `supply`.

params.name: life_seconds
params.doc: How long the task waits; 86400 at most, and that long when it is not named.

params.name: files
params.doc: `{name, content_type, text, repeat}`: a file of `text` written `repeat` times.

params.name: again
params.doc: `supply` opens the next task of the conversation when it answers this one.

params.name: seconds
params.doc: For a `confirm_slow` task: how long its run waits, 1 to 170 seconds, sealed with the task.

prepare_many.doc: Opens `count` tasks in one run, each as `prepare` makes it, and stops at the first refusal: answers the tasks opened, and the refusal's code and the number of the task refused.

params.name: count
params.doc: How many tasks to open, 1 to 10.

params.name: title
params.doc: The task's title, 80 characters at most. `Tasks probe` when it is not named.

params.name: body
params.doc: Shown as the field `Body`, sealed in the task's state, and handed back in the result.

params.name: kind
params.doc: `confirm` (when it is not named), `text` or `file`: what the owner answers with; or `notice`, which asks nothing and is answered `notified`.

params.name: answer_by
params.doc: The operation that answers a `confirm` task, and the only one that may: `confirm` (when it is not named), `confirm_slow`, `confirm_silent` or `confirm_trap`. A `text` or `file` task is answered by `supply`.

params.name: life_seconds
params.doc: How long the task waits; 86400 at most, and that long when it is not named.

params.name: files
params.doc: `{name, content_type, text, repeat}`: a file of `text` written `repeat` times.

params.name: again
params.doc: `supply` opens the next task of the conversation when it answers this one.

prepare_raw.doc: Opens a `confirm` task whose display is handed to the host as the call spells it.

params.name: display
params.doc: `{title, fields: [{label, kind, value | values}]}`.

params.name: state
params.doc: Sealed beside the task and handed back when it is answered.

params.name: answer_by
params.doc: The operation the task names, as given; `confirm` when it is not named.

params.name: life_seconds
params.doc: How long the task waits; 86400 at most.

notify.doc: Opens a notice for the owner of the row the run names: it tells them something and asks nothing, and needs no payment key. Answers `notified` with its id and hash; `task_status` reads it `open` until the owner presses Got it, then `done`.

params.name: title
params.doc: The notice's title, 80 characters at most. `Tasks probe` when it is not named.

params.name: body
params.doc: Shown as the field `Body`.

params.name: life_seconds
params.doc: How long the notice waits; 86400 at most, and that long when it is not named.

params.name: files
params.doc: `{name, content_type, text, repeat}`: a file of `text` written `repeat` times.

confirm.doc: Started by the platform as a run of the agent that prepared the task, on the owner's signed approval. Takes a task that names `confirm`, and reports what was prepared and the owner's note: the task ends `done`.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: The task answered.

params.name: task_hash
params.doc: SHA-256 of the task as the owner's page showed it.

params.name: approval
params.doc: The owner's approval as the platform puts it in the run's input: `at`, `public_key`, `signature`, `nonce`.

params.name: note
params.doc: What the owner wrote beside the approval, sealed to the task's reply key.

confirm_slow.doc: Started by the platform as a run of the agent that prepared the task, on the owner's signed approval. Takes a task that names `confirm_slow`, waits the task's `seconds`, then reports what was prepared: the task is `answering` for that long and ends `done`.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: The task answered.

params.name: task_hash
params.doc: SHA-256 of the task as the owner's page showed it.

params.name: seconds
params.doc: How long the run waits, 1 to 170. Read off the call when it names one; otherwise the value `prepare` sealed with the task.

params.name: approval
params.doc: The owner's approval as the platform puts it in the run's input: `at`, `public_key`, `signature`, `nonce`.

params.name: note
params.doc: What the owner wrote beside the approval, sealed to the task's reply key.

supply.doc: Started by the platform as a run of the agent that prepared the task, on the owner's signed approval. Takes a `text` or `file` task and reports what the owner supplied; a task prepared with `again` opens the next one, as the agent's.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: The task answered.

params.name: task_hash
params.doc: SHA-256 of the task as the owner's page showed it.

params.name: supplied
params.doc: What the owner supplies, sealed to the task's reply key, in base64.

params.name: approval
params.doc: The owner's approval as the platform puts it in the run's input: `at`, `public_key`, `signature`, `nonce`.

params.name: note
params.doc: What the owner wrote beside the approval, sealed to the task's reply key.

confirm_silent.doc: Started by the platform as a run of the agent that prepared the task, on the owner's signed approval. Takes a task that names `confirm_silent`, and reports nothing: the task ends `failed`.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: The task answered.

params.name: task_hash
params.doc: SHA-256 of the task as the owner's page showed it.

params.name: approval
params.doc: The owner's approval as the platform puts it in the run's input: `at`, `public_key`, `signature`, `nonce`.

params.name: note
params.doc: What the owner wrote beside the approval, sealed to the task's reply key.

confirm_trap.doc: Started by the platform as a run of the agent that prepared the task, on the owner's signed approval. Takes a task that names `confirm_trap`, reports, and traps: the task ends `failed`.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: The task answered.

params.name: task_hash
params.doc: SHA-256 of the task as the owner's page showed it.

params.name: approval
params.doc: The owner's approval as the platform puts it in the run's input: `at`, `public_key`, `signature`, `nonce`.

params.name: note
params.doc: What the owner wrote beside the approval, sealed to the task's reply key.

task_status.doc: One task this caller made: its state, and the result, the reason, the run and `failure_reason` when it has them.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: A task this caller made.

task_cancel.doc: Withdraws an open task this caller made.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: A task this caller made.

task_delete.doc: Deletes a task this caller made, in any state.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: A task this caller made.

tasks.doc: The tasks this caller made in this project for this owner; an empty list when there are none.

tasks_unlock.doc: The owner's run writes the copies of the waiting tasks for the device now in force, and answers how many wait.
